notes: No production or public API changes.
GPU Tree topology, numeric inputs and kernels unchanged.

Static membership changes drawn label rows and lifecycle work.

limitations: Temporary diagnostic fixture and wrappers are not production changes.
Fixed bounds use actual initial full domains and change selected-branch coverage. Static membership changes label count/lifecycle work. No same-image parity claim.
Observed active phase is native Tree procedural-track presence, bounded by last-present/first-absent passive samples; CPU pending states do not measure GPU row start times or GPU execution.
Per-row CPU deadlines can reset on unchanged uploads; actual GPU starts can remain preserved.
Awaited query spans and read waits overlap; their sums are not critical-path CPU or GPU duration. named-data-cpu is synchronous wall work including any blocking nested reads.
getImageData calls are nested implementations of .js reads; do not add both as independent semantic readbacks.
Other asynchronous callers remain unresolved. Net ablations do not isolate pure Tree GPU kernel cost.
Development server, shared Metal cache, fixed mode order and only3paired repetitions constrain timing conclusions. Point-depth-toggle work saved later in main is excluded from frozen source.
